recentItems.title: Golden Axe | Full Episode (S1, E2) | ”Rideable Beasts” | Paramount+
recentItems.description:

Meanwhile, Ax (Liam McIntyre) and Tyris (Lisa Gilroy) are embarrassed by their new teammate’s magical abilities. Worried about their image, they ask him to not use magic but in the conversation Ax and Tyris end up in an argument of their own.

Along the way, he meets the inexperienced and overeager Hampton Squib (Danny Pudi). Meanwhile, Ax and Tyris replace Gilius with half-panther, half-man Chronos Lait (Carl Tart).
